rows.text: with `o` = `rcx`: for each qword `p` from qword [o+0xA0] up to it + 8 times the 32-bit sum dword [o+0xAC] + dword [o+0xA8] sign-extended (compared for equality), when `p` is non-null: calls the vtable slot +0 with 1 of each non-null one of the dword [p+0x3C] qwords at qword [p+0x30] (none when that count is not above 0, signed), then `00210EB0(qword [p+0x30])` and `00809950(p, 0x40)`; calls `00210EB0(qword [o+0xA0])`; when `q` = qword [o+0x80] is non-null: slot +0 with 1 of each non-null qword from qword [q+0x28] up to qword [q+0x30], `00210EB0(qword [q+0x28])` and `00809950(q, 0x38)`; when `r` = qword [o+0x78] is non-null: `00210EB0` on qwords [r+0x38], [r+0x40] and [r+0x48], zeroing each after its call, then `00809950(r, 0x50)`; for qwords [o+0x88], [o+0x90] and [o+0x98] when non-null: `008000C0`, `007FFDD0` and `008003A0` on it, then `00809950` with 0x40, 0x38 and 0x38; when `t` = qword [o+0x70] is non-null: `00210EB0` on qwords [t+0x28] and [t+0x38], then `00809950(t, 0x48)`; tail-jumps to `007FFEE0(o+0x20)`
